## About
A & A Automotive & Transmission Repair is a car repair shop on County Line Road in Camby. We handle car repair and maintenance, and transmission repair is right there in our name.
Through A&A Transmissions, we also sell high-performance racing transmission parts for Chrysler transmissions and engines from our online catalog.
We're open weekdays, and customers have given us a 4.5 rating across 99 Google reviews.

## Services
- Car repair and maintenance: Repair and maintenance work for your car at our Camby shop.
- Transmission repair: Transmission repair is a core part of what we do.
- Racing transmission parts: High-performance racing transmission parts for Chrysler transmissions and engines, sold through our online catalog.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: Our hours are Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:30 PM EDT.

Q: How can I get technical advice?
A: Call (317) 831-5610 Monday through Thursday between 4:00 PM and 6:00 PM EDT, or email info@aandatrans.com.

Q: How do I get a parts catalog?
A: You can request one through the Customer Service section of our website.
